feeds.title: The Hipodrome Of Music » Cold Wave
feeds.description: The Hipodrome Of Music is a blog dedicated to electronic music. It was born in the Hipodrom neighborhood of Sibiu (Hermannstadt), Romania. The site aims to unearth the quality side of electronic music. They also have a YouTube channel where they post videos related to their music. The site has been active for several years, and they occasionally post year-end reviews.

feeds.title: Onyx Music Reviews » Cold Wave
feeds.description: My name is Adele and I live in Brisbane, Australia. Music has been a passion for my whole life fueled by my parents, and at 13 I became was was later termed a 'goth' (although in Brisbane we were originally called swampies which is actually kind of cute).

feeds.title: Records I Like » Coldwave
feeds.description: 'Records I Like' is a music blog that features a variety of genres and artists, with a focus on indie music. It shares mixes and does not accept submission requests. The blog is updated regularly and is a good resource for discovering new music.

feeds.title: THOUGHTS WORDS ACTION » Coldwave
feeds.description: Music reviews, news, premieres, interviews, and more. Music blog focused on punk rock, hardcore, post-hardcore, grunge, alternative, indie, emo, metal etc.

feeds.title: Wave Press
feeds.description: Wave Press is the music blog of the Transmission radio station - a place for sounds from the following genres: cold wave / minimal wave / synth wave / post punk / synth pop / ethereal. Up to date: reviews of albums and other publications; reports from festivals, concerts, exhibitions; conversations with musicians and cultural creators.

feeds.title: Kid With A Vinyl » Coldwave
feeds.description: 'Kid With A Vinyl' is an independent blog that is dedicated to sharing new music from around the globe. Every Friday, the blog is updated with fresh song reviews, a new album review, or occasionally, a long essay that revisits an album released over the past decade. These essays are referred to as 'KWAV Revisited'. The blog has a slight bias towards dream pop and post-punk, but it embraces all kinds of music. Since its inception in 2014, the blog's posts have covered a myriad of genres and micro-genres, including chillwave, psych rock, and glitch pop.
